scripts.preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.upload: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare upload --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:import:local: npm run d1:export-sql && wrangler d1 execute below-your-means --local --file data/d1-import.sql --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:import:remote: npm run d1:export-sql && wrangler d1 execute below-your-means --remote --file data/d1-import.sql --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply below-your-means --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply below-your-means --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.preview:karim: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.karim.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.karim.jsonc
scripts.deploy:karim: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.karim.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.karim.jsonc
scripts.deploy:both: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --config wrangler.karim.jsonc
scripts.upload:karim: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.karim.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare upload --config wrangler.karim.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:local:karim: wrangler d1 migrations apply below-your-means-karim --local --config wrangler.karim.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:remote:karim: wrangler d1 migrations apply below-your-means-karim --remote --config wrangler.karim.jsonc
